body:
We may have a performance issue because of updating the url bar at each keystroke. This is platform dependent as @bobylito said so we need to be careful here before taking a decision.

I am not sure in term of UX updating the url bar at each keystroke is the best idea, the more I use it the more it "feels" less performant because not only the whole screen is updating but also the url bar which can be confusing (== where do I need to look on my screen? urlbar? webpage?). It can be taken as "noise"

Maybe just updating the urlbar only after the thresold could be sufficient in term of UX.

Today we both update it at each key stroke AND after the thresold

As for the performance problem of @olance it may be related to the replaceState at each keystroke, we need a real video comparison without any dev tool nor extension loaded of the before/after activating it @olance, thanks!
